direct-workflow: Run Dash and Blitz work outside the full pipeline.
direct-workflow blitz survey: Record the paths a Blitz item changes and check conflicts.
direct-workflow conflict-survey status: Show an item's conflict survey and check it again.
direct-workflow dash: Survey, finish and escalate Dash work.
direct-workflow dash escalate: File an issue with findings and cancel the Dash item.
direct-workflow dash evidence: Record a Dash item's result and how it was checked.
direct-workflow dash survey: Record the paths a Dash item changes and check conflicts.
direct-workflow worktree: Prepare lanes for Dash and Blitz work.
direct-workflow worktree prepare: Prepare an item's lane from the latest upstream.
